added_lines: november envelopes and the parish november programme leaflet are now being distributed to parishioners’ homes. if you do not receive an envelope, they are available at the back of the church and the parish centre. you can use the envelope to return a list of your beloved dead to be remembered during the parish november masses for the faithful departed and also for the customary november offering for the support of the parish clergy. the priests of the parish wish to thank you for your ongoing generosity and support. sincere thanks also to all our parish distributors who faithfully deliver our parish literature throughout the year remembering deceased colleagues & friends this november, we wish to invite any club, organisation, workplace or group that would like to remember and pray for their deceased colleagues and friends at mass to attend any one of our friday 6.10pm masses for the holy souls in st. john’s church on fridays 14th, 21st or 28th november. we would be delighted to have your group or organisation mentioned and included in prayer. organisers are asked to contact st. john’s parish centre giving details and the preferred date of inclusion in any one of these friday 6.10pm masses for the holy souls recent weddings: congratulations to: david sullivan & grace kiely who married in st. john’s parish recently. we pray that god will bless your marriage . saturday november 1st is the feast of all saints and is a holy day vigil masses on friday evening st john’s church : 6.10pm immaculate conception rathass: 7.00pm st brendan’s curraheen : 7.30pm times of masses on saturday st. john 8.30am (as gaeilge), 10.00am & 6.10pm immaculate conception rathass :10.00am & 7.00pm st. brendan’s curraheen : 7.30pm ordinations to the diaconate you are cordially invited to attend the ordinations into the permanent diaconate in the diocese of kerry of shane lehane (st. john tralee), michael o connell (caherciveen), linus burke (milltown), christopher lynch (killorglin & fenit) & brian godfrey (listowel) at st mary’s cathedral, killarney, saturday 8th november at 12 noon. followed by a reception of refreshments afterwards in st brendan’s college. all most welcome to attend. we keep shane in our prayers as he prepares for ordination. bank holiday please note the parish centre will be closed on monday october 27th due to the bank holiday there will be no 8.30am mass on monday biblical walk through the mass in response to the irish bishops document “why sunday matters ” join us for a biblical walk through the mass continu- ing tuesday nov 4th at 7.30pm in the parish centre. tea and coffee provided. all are welcome to attend st john's
